Why wool & silk

Warm in winter, light in spring, soft all year

  • Wool insulates and manages moisture, so you stay warm without overheating.
  • Silk is light and smooth, and takes away the itch some people feel from pure wool.
  • Together they make a thin, second-skin layer that disappears under your clothes.

Handbags

Hand-woven in Italy. Seamless by design.

Each bag is woven by hand from soft leather using the tubular method, which leaves it without a single seam. Finished with gold-tone hardware, from the evening pochette to the everyday shopper.

Our story

Beautiful things that are natural and long-lasting

Closetoskin was founded in Oslo in 2009 by a group of friends who met as students in London. We grew up by the Caribbean sea, and the feeling of silk against the body is what feels like home to us.

Our idea is simple: modern basics in natural materials (wool, silk, cotton and cashmere) that are comfortable, timeless and made to last.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Shipping & returns
How long does delivery take?
Delivery within Norway is free on every order and takes 2–5 business days with Posten. Orders ship Monday to Friday; weekend orders ship the next business day.
Do you ship outside Norway?
Our online checkout currently delivers within Norway. For orders to other countries, email info@closetoskin.com and we'll help you.
What is your return and exchange policy?
You can return or exchange items within 14 days of delivery, as long as they are in perfect condition with tags and seal attached. We happily exchange to a different size, subject to stock. Return shipping is paid by the customer.
What are your underwear made of?
Our underwear is made from natural fibres: wool & silk blends (85/15 and 70/30), pure 100% silk, and a cotton, wool & silk blend. The exact composition is listed on every product page.
